meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一件大活拆给多个 AI 小组分头做,并盯着它们回报进度直到收尾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时有好几个 AI 任务在跑,需要有人分派、盯梢并汇总结果
copy.tagline_en: Split a big job across several AI workers and supervise them through to completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run several AI tasks at once and need someone to dispatch, track and merge results

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以协调多个受监督的 Orca worker:收发线程消息、阻塞式提问与回复、派发任务、等待 worker_done 或升级、跑任务 DAG、设决策门、跑协调循环,并把工作拆分给不同 agent。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多 agent 协调(线程消息、ask/reply、任务 DAG 等),或要求监督、监控、等待结果、协调 DAG 时接管;纯属所有权交接或终端控制则走 orca-cli。

say.text: 把这个任务拆成 DAG,分派给几个 Orca worker 并盯进度
say.note: 会走任务分发与 worker_done 等待

say.text: 向正在跑的那个 worker 提问,阻塞等它回复
到决策门时先停下,把选项给我确认

howto.what_en: Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, waiting on worker_done or escalations, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and splitting work across agents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need structured multi-agent coordination — threaded messages, ask/reply, task DAGs, etc. — or ask to supervise, monitor, wait for results, or coordinate a DAG.

say_en.text: Break this into a task DAG, dispatch it to several Orca workers, and track progress
say_en.note: Runs task dispatch and worker_done waits

say_en.text: Ask the running worker a question and block until it replies
Stop at the decision gate and show me the options to confirm
say_en.note: Waits for your call at the gate
